title: 147873187 - 42-t-7585721-20060476F-001-006-2013
doc_notes: This document is a 1995 GAO report investigating government records concerning the 1947 Roswell incident, containing correspondence from various federal agencies regarding their lack of additional records.

incidents.summary: Recovery of an airborne object near Roswell, New Mexico, initially reported as a flying disc and later identified by the military as a radar-tracking balloon.
incidents.explanation: Identified by the military as a radar-tracking balloon, later associated with Project Mogul.
incidents.quote: The object turned out to be a radar tracking balloon.
